services.name: Welcome to Iron Horse Farm
services.desc: We’ve had this in the works for a while now, but we’re excited to officially announce that Chincoteague Minnow will be attending the PA Horse World Expo in Harrisburg, PA from Thursday, February 23 through Sunday, February 26, 2012. Last year Boomerang and Kyley attended the expo to compete in the Craig Cameron Extreme Cowboy Race, in which they finished 6th in the finals! This year they aren’t competing in the Cowboy Race though, instead we will be in the main hall at booth # 607 & 608! And if that wasn’t exciting enough, Minnow will be there too, corralled at our booth and on hand to meet his fans and paint! Kyley will be bringing many of the ponies original works of art with us as well
